title: Spider-Man Is Coming Back to Cinemas
summary: Spider-Man is swinging back to the movies. The film Spider-Man: Brand New Day will return to theaters on December 4. Tickets go on sale November 19. The film is already the biggest movie ever in the United States. Sony, the studio that made it, wants to earn even more money. The new version will be a longer cut. It will have one extra scene that was cut from the first version. In the scene, Rosario Dawson plays a character called the Night Nurse. The film is only $41 million away from earning $1 billion in the United States. Sony hopes the return will push it over that big number. Sony also thinks the film could win awards. The studio is running a campaign to get people to think about it for Best Picture. The only other big new film on December 4 is Violent Night 2. But Christmas will be busy, with Jumanji: Open World and Avengers: Doomsday also coming out.
why_it_matters: Movies kids love can break records, and re-releases give fans a second chance to see them.
